mapper.select: SELECT cj.clubJoin_num AS applyNum, cj.clubOwner_key AS clubOwner_key, cj.memberIdx AS memberIdx, m1.userName AS userName, TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, m2.birth) / 12) AS userAge, cj.clubJoin_position AS position, TO_CHAR(cj.clubJoin_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS applyDate, cj.clubJoin_intro AS memo, cj.clubJoin_content AS content, cj.clubJoin_result AS status FROM clubJoin cj JOIN member1 m1 ON cj.memberIdx = m1.memberIdx LEFT JOIN member2 m2 ON m1.memberIdx = m2.memberIdx WHERE cj.clubOwner_key = #{clubOwnerKey} AND cj.clubJoin_result = 2 ORDER BY cj.clubJoin_date DESC
SELECT clubJoin_num AS applyNum, clubOwner_key AS clubOwner_key, memberIdx AS memberIdx, clubJoin_position AS position FROM clubJoin WHERE clubJoin_num = #{applyNum}
